chunks: A man came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and said: "Pray to Allah to admit me into Paradise."
So he said to him: "Help me by increasing your prostration."

key_terms.أَعِنِّي: Assist me; help me in securing this outcome for you
key_terms.يُدْخِلَنِيَ: Cause me to enter; admit me
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَّةَ: Paradise; the abode of reward in the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: How does frequent prostration help a believer attain Paradise?
ai.summary: A man asked the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to supplicate for his entry into Paradise. He replied by directing him to abundant sajdah, showing that frequent worship and devotion are a means to attaining jannah.
